What are some truly underrated artists, authors, or musicians?
Phil Ochs. He's still fairly big in the topical scene.
Benji Hughes is a criminally underrated songwriter. His album A Love Extreme is one of the best collections of songs that I have ever heard.

I wouldn't necessarily call him underrated, but I feel like not enough people know of Mike Oldfield's work. I mean, yes, he had success with Tubular Bells and Moonlight Shadow, but he's done so much more. Music of the Spheres is pretty good.

If you like weird short stories, you could do a lot worse than James Purdy. I had never heard of him, but for some reason picked up 'The Candles of Your Eyes' in the library a long time ago.
